title: merge_into

event_id.description: Event ID (EVT-…); find it with read-only SQL (tank-data data guide, «Finding record IDs for tool arguments»), «Events by statement, time or token».

description: Merge the current event into the earlier open event that covers the same real-world development, named by its event_id. Observations and claims move to the surviving event, which keeps the earlier known-to-us time; the current event becomes MERGED.
